label: Local evidence ledger record policy

record_type_meanings.source_observation: Reviewable observation about a source or source locator.
record_type_meanings.source_cache_derived_claim: Future draft claim derived from a reviewed source-cache record.
record_type_meanings.metadata_claim: Claim about metadata presence or value.
record_type_meanings.identity_claim: Claim about possible identity or relation.
record_type_meanings.compatibility_claim: Claim about compatibility evidence, not compatibility truth.
record_type_meanings.checksum_claim: Claim about a reported checksum or hash value.
record_type_meanings.filename_or_member_claim: Claim about a file/member name or container member.
record_type_meanings.source_locator: Locator or citation context, not permission to fetch.
record_type_meanings.pack_claim: Claim derived from a future reviewed pack.
record_type_meanings.contribution_claim: Claim derived from a future contribution path.
record_type_meanings.review_status_record: Record of review state or decision.
record_type_meanings.provenance_link: Record linking claim, source, and derivation.
record_type_meanings.ai_draft_future: Future draft vocabulary only; not evidence truth.
record_type_meanings.discussion_derived_future: Future discussion-derived vocabulary only; not public truth.

notes: Evidence ledger records are candidates and provenance events by default.
Accepted-public status is future vocabulary only and must not appear in current examples.
